title: canvas knife wrap
text: canvas knife wrap. I purchased to house the knife set I travel with.  I hate low quality cutlery you find at rentals - so I travel with a set and good sharpener.  The canvas wrap is thick and appears to be well made.  Slots for 3 knives, wrap and cloth tie.  It is black.  I just started using it, so time and wear will tell. Having said all of that, I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.
